description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of various models across three different evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis displays the categorical models without an overall axis label, ordered from left to right as Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and a final category whose label is visually obscured by a grey rectangle. The vertical axis represents the measured value, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to slightly above 0.8, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2 and minor tick marks every 0.05. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend at the top center, these bars represent different metrics: "Sentiment Acc." in light beige, "STS Corr." in light pink, and "Paraphrase Acc." in light blue. Across the categories, the light beige "Sentiment Acc." bars remain relatively stable, ranging from approximately 0.49 in the Supervised_SimCSE and obscured categories to a high of about 0.53 in the Single-task_baseline. The light pink "STS Corr." bars exhibit a consistent increase from left to right, starting at the lowest overall value of approximately 0.50 for the Single-task_baseline and peaking at the highest overall value of approximately 0.81 for the obscured category. The light blue "Paraphrase Acc." bars maintain a consistently high level across all groups, fluctuating slightly between approximately 0.77 and 0.79. The categories do not appear to be sorted alphabetically or by a single overall descending or ascending value, and the only visual emphasis is the grey redaction box covering the label of the fifth category on the horizontal axis.
